title: FairEnc: A Fair Vision-Language Model with Fair Vision and Text Encoders for Glaucoma Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Demographic Parity Difference (DPD), Difference in Equalized Odds (DEOdds), and subgroup-specific AUC/F1 scores for glaucoma detection across racial groups (Asian, Black, White) using zero-shot and linear probing evaluations.

Measuring Demographic Parity Difference (DPD), Difference in Equalized Odds (DEOdds), and subgroup-specific AUC/F1 scores for glaucoma detection across gender groups (Female, Male) on both the Harvard-FairVLMed and FairFundus datasets.

Measuring Demographic Parity Difference (DPD), Difference in Equalized Odds (DEOdds), and subgroup-specific AUC/F1 scores for glaucoma detection across ethnic groups (Non-Hispanic, Hispanic) using the Harvard-FairVLMed dataset.

Measuring Demographic Parity Difference (DPD), Difference in Equalized Odds (DEOdds), and subgroup-specific AUC/F1 scores for glaucoma detection across preferred language groups (English, Spanish, Others) using the Harvard-FairVLMed dataset.

Measuring Demographic Parity Difference (DPD), Difference in Equalized Odds (DEOdds), and subgroup-specific AUC/F1 scores for glaucoma detection across age groups (0-30, 30-60, 60-90) on the FairFundus dataset.
